title: CST: Lightweight Risk Triage with Source-Grounded Evidence for Web Discussions
abstract: arXiv:2611.01710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web communities rely on moderators to catch harmful messages such as insults, hate speech, and scams, but no one can read every message. Existing tools give each message a risk score, which tells moderators where to look but not what to read or how to check it. Yet meaning depends on context: the same reply, "I agree.", can support or oppose removing someone from a group. Moderators therefore need source-grounded evidence, not just scores: a few key messages kept with their original wording and replies. We present CST, a lightweight triage pipeline that first decides where to look, then what to show. It scores risk by pairing character patterns, which capture exact wording, with sentence meaning from a fixed multilingual model, so it handles several languages and runs on an ordinary CPU. It then groups related messages and picks from each group in turn, so a small reading budget covers different parts of a discussion, and links every pic

translated_title: CST：面向网络讨论的轻量级风险分流与基于源文本的证据系统
translated_abstract: 网络社区依靠版主来发现诸如侮辱、仇恨言论和诈骗等有害消息，但没有人能读完全部消息。现有工具为每条消息给出一个风险分数，这能告诉版主该看哪里，却不能告诉他们该读什么或如何核实。然而，含义取决于上下文：同样的回复“我同意。”，既可能支持、也可能反对将某人移出群组。因此，版主需要基于源文本的证据，而不仅仅是分数：即保留原始措辞及其回复的少数关键消息。我们提出了CST，一个轻量级的分流流水线，它先决定该看哪里，再决定该展示什么。它通过将捕捉确切措辞的字符模式与来自固定多语言模型的句子含义相结合来评估风险，因此能够处理多种语言，并可在普通CPU上运行。随后，它将相关消息分组，并从每组中依次选取，使有限的阅读预算能够覆盖讨论的不同部分，并将每条被选中的消息（原文此处截断）
tldr: CST是一个可在普通CPU上运行的轻量级风险分流系统，它通过结合字符模式与固定多语言模型的句子含义来评估消息风险，并将相关消息分组后从各组依次选取，为版主提供保留原始措辞与回复的、基于源文本的证据。
en_tdlr: CST is a lightweight, CPU-runnable triage pipeline that scores discussion risk by combining character patterns with a fixed multilingual sentence model, then presents moderators with source-grounded evidence—key messages preserved with their original wording and replies—selected across grouped parts of a discussion within a small reading budget.
